about_the_game:
The Last Squad is

Survive the night. Prepare in the day.

The Last Squad is a class-based co-op third-person shooter where players scavenge for supplies by day and fight off hordes of zombies by night.
Each in-game day consists of a strategic resource gathering phase, followed by a high-intensity survival wave with elite and boss-type zombies waiting at the end.

🎮 Core Modes

  • Main Scenario Mode: Progress through story-driven stages with increasing difficulty.

  • Endless Challenge Mode: Survive as long as you can against never-ending zombie waves.

⚔️ Gameplay Features

  • 4-player co-op with distinct class roles: Tank, DPS, and Healer

  • Designed for strategic team play and high difficulty for well-coordinated squads

  • Minimum 3 hours of gameplay with replayable structure and unlocks

🔧 Progression Systems

  • In-game progression: Upgrade hero skills each day; spend resources in the underground bunker to enhance weapons.

  • Out-of-game meta: Earn XP to unlock perks and enhance your hero’s abilities and role.

  • Customization: Purchase character skins and emotes using earned currency.

Survive together, grow stronger, and become the last squad standing.

🛠️ Under Development

Hero Traits and Customization are currently under development and will be available in a future update.

Thank you for your patience and understanding!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64Bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-10600 / AMD Ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 2060 / AMD Radeon RX 5700
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 6 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64Bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-11600 / AMD Ryzen 5 5600
  • Memory: 16 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 3060 / AMD Radeon RX 6600
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 8 GB available space
